general.a1: Tibia Wise is a platform that helps Tibia players track their hunt statistics, characters and hunting recommendations.
general.q2: Do I need to create an account?
general.a2: No, you can view public statistics without an account. To save your data, you need to register an account.

account.q1: How do I change my e-mail?
account.a1: You can change your e-mail in your account settings, in the profile section.
account.q2: How do I recover my password?
account.a2: Use the "Forgot my password" link on the login page. You will receive an e-mail with instructions.

technical.q1: Why are the charts not loading?
technical.a1: This may be caused by ad-blocker filters or network issues. Try reloading the page or temporarily disabling the ad-blocker.
technical.q2: How do I clear the browser cache?
technical.a2: In your browser settings, go to Privacy and clear browsing data, select "Cookies and other site data" and click Clear data.

premium.q1: How does the premium plan work?
premium.a1: The premium plan offers advanced statistics, unlimited charts, personalized recommendations and priority support.
premium.a2: Yes, you can cancel your premium plan anytime in the subscription settings.

faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions

general.q1: How do I recover my account?
general.a1: Use the "Forgot my password" link on the login page. You will receive an e-mail with instructions.
general.q2: Where can I find my hunts statistics?
general.a2: Go to the Statistics page in the main menu after logging in.

billing.q1: How do I cancel my subscription?
billing.a1: You can cancel it in your account settings. The cancellation takes effect at the end of the current period.
billing.a2: We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), Pix and PayPal.

technical.q1: Is the site slow or showing errors?
technical.a1: Try clearing your browser cache, disabling extensions and reloading the page. If it persists, contact us.
technical.q2: How do I export my data?
technical.a2: Settings > Privacy > Export Data provides your data in CSV.

account.q1: How do I change my e-mail?
account.a1: Go to Settings > Profile to update your e-mail.
account.q2: How do I delete my account?
account.a2: Settings > Privacy > Delete Account. This action is irreversible.
